title: The Walls came Tumbling Down
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s Bible lesson 
you will see what happens next to God’s people,
the Israelites and Joshua.

GOD CAN DO ANYTHING!
THEY LISTENED TO GOD AND DID WHAT HE TOLD THEM AND THEY WON……

For 6 days they marched around the walled city
in silence, no war cries

THE PRIESTS CARRIED THE GOLDEN ARK AND BLEW RAM HORNS

On day 7 - they marched around the city 7 times
and then
THEY SHOUTED
and the walls came tumbling down!

They rescued RAHAB and her family 
as they had promised when she hid the spies a few weeks ago

Using building blocks or lego build a walled city with very high walls like today’s story

THEN MARCH AROUND YOUR CITY WALL ONCE
SILENTLY
THEN REST
(DO THAT 6 TIMES - MARCH - REST - MARCH - REST - MARCH - REST)
THEN 
MARCH AROUND YOUR CITY 7 TIMES
AND THEN SHOUT

TALK TO JESUS
Dear Lord Jesus
You can do anything
You are so mighty and strong
Thank you for loving me and looking after me
Amen
